com_hh_description: Configure the shared employer account used by the HeadHunter MCP server.
com_hh_secret_saved: Secret saved; leave empty to keep it
com_hh_secret_help: The secret is encrypted and never returned to the browser. Changing the application requires reconnecting HH.
com_hh_redirect_help: Copy this address into your application settings in the HH developer account. It must match exactly.
com_hh_copy_failed: Select and copy the address manually.
com_hh_empty: Application not configured. Enter Client ID and Client Secret.
com_hh_ready: Application saved. Connect the employer account.
com_hh_connected: HH authorization is saved. Use Check account to verify employer access.
com_hh_account_help: After saving, sign in on HH and allow access. Everyone who can use this MCP connection acts through this shared employer account.
com_hh_unavailable: HeadHunter administration is not enabled on this deployment.
com_hh_callback_failed: Authorization failed or expired. Check Client ID and Client Secret, then connect again.
com_hh_cancel_success: Authorization cancelled. You can try again.
com_hh_error_forbidden: You do not have permission to manage integrations.
com_hh_error_service_unavailable: Cannot reach the integration server. Retry shortly.
com_hh_error_secret_required: Enter Client Secret for this application.
com_hh_error_save_failed: Settings could not be saved. Retry.
com_hh_error_authorization_failed: HH rejected the authorization code. Check the application credentials and try again.
com_hh_error_employer_required: This account is not an employer. Reconnect with an employer account.
com_hh_error_verification_failed: Could not verify HH access. Retry or reconnect the account.
com_hh_error_disconnect_failed: Could not disconnect the account. Retry.
com_hh_pending: Finish signing in on HH or cancel this authorization.
